; ------------------------------------------------------------------
; Per enemy type. Generated by trainer/gen_spawn_tables.py from the
; level data do not reorder by hand.
;
; The value is a percentage of the EXTRA enemies, not of the enemies
; the level places by itself:
;     0 = never add any of this type, leave it exactly as shipped
;   100 = follow MoreEnemiesPercent
;   200 = this type gets twice the extra the others get
;
; At MoreEnemiesPercent=200 the extra is +100. A type set to 50 then
; gets +50, so it ends up at 150 percent while everything else sits
; at 200. A type set to 0 is left untouched whatever the global is.
;
; Only types confirmed as real enemies in the level data appear
; here. Props, triggers and boss-stage objects are blocked without
; a switch, deliberately there is no key to turn them on.
;
; The number after the name is how many spawn points in the game
; use that type, so it tells you how much a change will be felt.
; ------------------------------------------------------------------
